COLORADO GEOLOGICAL SURVEY (CGS) FEES
(Make checks payable to the Colorado Geological Survey)
Initial Submittal and Resubmittal
$125
Subdivisions
Subdivisions of 1 - 3 residential lots and less than 100 acres
$600
All other subdivisions of less than 100 acres
$950
Subdivisions of 100 to 500 acres
$1,550
Subdivisions of greater than 500 acres
$2,500
School Site Review
$855
Special Review
Applies to all projects submitted to CGS for review, and to all 
resubmittals
Special reviews include all non-school projects referred to CGS that
do not involve platting new lots. Examples: site development plans
for
existing
lots,
rezones,
location
&
extent
reviews,
lot
line
adjustments, lot line and easement vacations, oil & gas, wind, and
solar projects, 1041 Matters of State Interest, and building, driveway,
and OWTS permit applications. The fee for Special Reviews generally
ranges from no additional fee to $1500 depending on complexity,
and cannot be prepaid.
